title: PCR Preparation Protocol for Up to 32 Samples
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload your labware definition files (JSON format) for a PCR preparation of up to 32 samples.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol file (Python extension .py) to the OT App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up the deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate all labware, the tip rack, and the pipette; consult the support articles for calibration tips if needed.

substeps.instruction: Run the labware calibration routine for each piece of labware.
